# Tacos Barron

> Taco Truck in San Antonio, Texas. Birria, quesabirria and consomé with plenty of meat. Mini tacos too. Wednesday to Sunday nights.

- Phone: (949) 627-5381
- Address: 8630 US-90, San Antonio, TX 78227
- Areas: San Antonio, Converse, Schertz, Boerne, New Braunfels
- Offers: Quesabirria; Birria tacos and consomé; Trompo al pastor and cabeza
- Rating: 4.8 from 71 Google reviews
